| Behaviour does not depend on how much was toggled (95) | — no check named in the section |
| The disc's density follows the notes on screen (101) | — no check named in the section |
| The hub stays the same share of the disc (179) | — no check named in the section |
| The camera reframes on a visibility toggle, but only while it wasn't already touched (202) | a range change animates instead of snapping (2346); a bar that loses its folder shrinks over the cascade instead of blinking out (4344) |
| Every note is filed exactly once, in either dimension (250) | — no check named in the section |
| A plan over the whole circle is the resting disc, and over half of it stays in half (298) | — no check named in the section |

| The rings are independent (340) | — no check named in the section |
